title: Booking Notice Rates for Missed Appointments, Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
How far ahead an appointment was booked sets the notice multiplier of the missed-appointment charge on a Calloway Limited Home Warranty coverage; the multiplier is applied to the program's missed-appointment fee.

**Rule.** The notice multiplier compares the date the missed appointment was booked with its appointment date, in calendar days: an appointment booked fewer than 2 days ahead takes 0.50, one booked 2 to 6 days ahead takes 0.75, and one booked 7 or more days ahead takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment. The booking date is the date on which the appointment for that claim item and that appointment date was booked, as the coverage's appointment records show it; the days ahead are the calendar days from that booking date to the appointment date.

| Calendar days from booking to the appointment date | Notice multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 (booked the same day) | 0.50 |
| 1 | 0.50 |
| 2 | 0.75 |
| 6 | 0.75 |
| 7 | 1.00 |
| more than 7 | 1.00 |

**Edges of each band.** The 0.50 band ends at 1 day ahead, and 2 days ahead opens the 0.75 band; the 0.75 band ends at 6 days ahead, and 7 days ahead takes 1.00.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An appointment booked on 3 June for 9 June was booked 6 days ahead and takes 0.75; had it been booked on 2 June, it would have been booked 7 days ahead and taken 1.00.
